ROUND 1 — Leading direction: 'Highlighter Editorial'

Kept: the B mark, bellow yellow #F8ED2F, light/near-black base, and the site's existing fonts — Oxygen, Cardo, Oxygen Mono (per Leo). Evolved: a real dark mode and template anatomy for AI citation. Spacing, sizes, and radii sit on Tailwind v4 tokens so TailwindKit can express everything.

Nav change to sanity-check: Sponsorship moved from the top nav into the footer.

Designed from repo source (styles.css tokens, Plot components, real Content markdown) — live-site screenshots were not capturable from this sandbox.

Article template = the AI-CITE money page:
- visible published + updated dates (#129); '[per-page date]' is the placeholder #167 wires up
- answer-first 'Short Answer' box above the fold
- question-style H2s, styled comparison table
- in-article subscribe using the real subscriptionCTA front-matter copy

Episode page: the YouTube and Transistor players are VENDOR IFRAMES, so they are reserved slots here, not designed chrome — their UI belongs to YouTube/Transistor. One audio slot only (fixes the #164 double player).

Alternate directions — low-fi sketches, same real copy.
B 'Terminal Mono' and C 'Warm Editorial' state their motivation + tradeoff in their caption bars. A (above) is the balance of the two. Pick one, or mix elements onto A.
